original.target_description: ANOVA main effect of display size (four versus eight letters) on target-identification reaction time, Experiment 1a; both object-proximal and object-distal hand postures. Twenty college-aged participants responded using their hands; hands were visible beside the monitor in the proximal condition. The supplied pray/post posture wording does not identify the postures used in this original study.

n.sample_role: Participants in the Experiment 1a within-participant ANOVA. The printed enrollment of twenty is corroborated by the target ANOVA denominator df of 19.
n.exclusions: Participant exclusions are not reported. Trial exclusion rules for this ANOVA are not specified; feedback thresholds are described, but feedback is not evidence of exclusion.
n.location: Printed p. 1037 (PDF p. 3), section 2.1.1 Subjects; corroborating test df on printed p. 1038 (PDF p. 4), section 2.2.
n.quote: Twenty participants served in Experiments 1a and 1c, 12 served in 1b.

es.location: Printed p. 1038 (PDF p. 4), section 2.2 Results and discussion, Experiment 1a main effect of display-size.
es.quote: main eﬀect of display-size, F(1, 19) = 73.9, p < 0.001 for Experiment 1a;

p.location: Printed p. 1038 (PDF p. 4), section 2.2 Results and discussion, same Experiment 1a ANOVA test as es.
p.quote: main eﬀect of display-size, F(1, 19) = 73.9, p < 0.001 for Experiment 1a;

notes: Source version: published author personal copy; title, authors, journal, year, and DOI agree with the supplied original reference. Assigned original side only. The located Experiment 1a and statistical contrast match the study and intended outcome, but target_match is false under the exact-match requirement because the supplied description specifies pray and post postures, whereas this source uses object-proximal (hands beside monitor) and object-distal (hands on lap) postures. No pray/post conditions were located. Extracted the explicitly named Experiment 1a test without substituting another experiment. No statistic was converted.
